mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, stock, category, image_url, status, is_seckill, seckill_price, seckill_start_time, seckill_end_time, created_by, created_date, last_modified_by, last_modified_date) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{isSeckill}, #{seckillPrice}, #{seckillStartTime}, #{seckillEndTime}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDate}, #{lastModifiedBy}, #{lastModifiedDate})
